_about: First real PPO runs: PPO v0 against 3 random bots, 5 seeds. Run with: python -m rl.run_ppo_seeds experiments/ppo/first_runs.json (keys starting with _ are comments).
name: first_runs
_parallel: SET FROM THE BENCHMARK: conclusion.runs_side_by_side in benchmark.json (the 'best for 5 seeds' line).

config._total_timesteps: SET ME: the steps per seed. From the laptop benchmark: conclusion.steps_per_seed_per_night in benchmark.json (printed as 'one 8-hour night: N steps per seed'). It is 8 h x 3600 x (speed of one run when 'parallel' runs share the CPU) x 0.95 / ceil(5 / parallel), rounded down to whole rollouts of 2,048 steps. The plan refuses to start while this is null.
config._eval_every: SET ME: the evaluation interval. From the benchmark: conclusion.smallest_eval_every_for_5_percent (or larger), so 50 worst-case games cost at most about 5% of training time.
config._vec_env_torch_threads: SET FROM THE BENCHMARK: conclusion.vec_env and conclusion.torch_threads_each.
